attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Social Work (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved continuing education (general rules for social work, R 338.2961).
rules.audit_note: Certify at renewal; keep documentation 5 years (implicit bias certificates 6 years); audited licensees submit proof. CE Broker tracking available.

topics.who: At least 2 of the 45 hours each cycle (R 338.2961(4))
1 hour per year of the 3-year license cycle (3 per cycle); may count toward general CE since March 23, 2023

rules.notes: 45 hours in the 3 years before expiration; at least half must be in person / live synchronous. Renewal cycle 3 years; renewal fee $82.50 (LMSW and LBSW).
